'''Estanda''' is a [[High Nobility of Tear#List of High Lords and Ladies of Tear|High Lady]] of [[Tear]]. 

== Appearance ==
She has a stern face which masks her beauty.

== Activities ==
She has an intense dislike for the [[Alteima|High Lady Alteima]]. Alteima is sent to [[Cairhien]] with the Army of Tear, and Estanda is to look after her sick husband in her apartments until he has recovered.{{ref/book|4|21}}

Later, in open rebellion and treason, she hides out in [[Haddon Mirk]]. She is convinced to do this by [[Sebban Balwer]]'s agents, who in turn is working for [[Pedron Niall]].

She becomes the leader of the rebel [[High Nobility of Tear#List of High Lords and Ladies of Tear|High Lords]] of Tear and moves all her troops to the [[Stone of Tear]] where they lay siege, seizing any livestock that comes her way. She agrees to lift the siege if [[Darlin Sisnera]] is made King of Tear, in return she will pay the city for food for the next year but will retain her lands and titles.

She greets [[Rand al'Thor]] with King Darlin when Rand withdraws his forces from [[Arad Doman]] back into Tear.
